gloss: being bad at getting along in the world; social ineptness

definitions.gloss: being bad at getting along in the world; social ineptness; poor life skills
definitions.explanation: The quality of being unskilled at navigating social relationships, workplace politics, or the practical demands of adult life.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{世渡|よわた}り{下手|べた}だ。
examples.english: He's bad at getting along in the world.

examples.japanese: ⟦{正直|しょうじき}→正直：01562_shoujiki⟧すぎて{世渡|よわた}り{下手|べた}な⟦ところ→ところ：01137_tokoro⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: He's so honest that he can be bad at navigating social situations.

examples.japanese: {世渡|よわた}り{下手|べた}で⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧、⟦{実力|じつりょく}→実力：03277_jitsuryoku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦あれば→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{認|みと}められる→認める：02429_mitomeru⟧こと⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Even if you're socially inept, you can be recognized if you have real ability.

notes:
Composed of ⟦{世渡|よわた}り→世渡り：07736_yowatari⟧ (getting along in the world; making one's way through life) + {下手|べた} (unskilled at). Implies someone who is too honest, awkward, or principled to play social games effectively. Often used with a degree of sympathy or self-deprecation, not purely as criticism.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {世渡|よわた}り{下手|べた}な⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧: a socially inept person
- ⟦{世渡|よわた}り→世渡り：07736_yowatari⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{下手|へた}→下手：00703_heta⟧: to be bad at navigating the world

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{世渡|よわた}り{上手|じょうず}→世渡り上手：08496_yowatarijouzu⟧: skilled at getting along in the world — the opposite; someone who smoothly navigates social and professional life
- ⟦{不器用|ぶきよう}→不器用：06642_bukiyou⟧: clumsy; awkward — broader; can refer to physical or social clumsiness
- ⟦{要領|ようりょう}が{悪|わる}い→要領が悪い：20144_youryougawarui⟧: inefficient; awkward at handling things — describes poor practical judgment more than social skills
